mainFocus: Confirm which development areas are most useful to the team and realistic to support.
projects: Manager review of training, exposure, tooling and automation requests
outcome: A clear view of which requests are appropriate, which need adjustment and which should be deferred.

detailSections.title: Discussion Points
items: Which areas align best with current team priorities
Which requests need approval from other teams
Which items should be handled formally and which can happen organically

detailSections.title: Expected Output
items: Agreed priority order
Clear next actions
Any policy or approval constraints identified

mainFocus: Confirm suitable tooling, source control guidance and any available training or exam support.
outcome: A safe and approved setup for learning, documentation and small automation prototypes.

detailSections.title: Actions
items: Confirm approved tooling for scripting and documentation
Confirm whether GitHub or an internal source control platform should be used
Clarify whether certification exams, course costs or both can be supported

detailSections.title: Expected Output
items: Approved tool list
Training decision for AZ-104 and MS-102
Source control and portfolio guidance

mainFocus: Begin small, supervised exposure opportunities and identify a realistic first automation task.
projects: Shadowing and first supervised automation task
outcome: Practical learning begins in a controlled way while still supporting Service Desk responsibilities.

detailSections.title: Actions
items: Sit in on relevant meetings or planned work where appropriate
Assist with a lower-risk task or documentation item
Select one automation idea that is useful, small and reviewable

detailSections.title: Expected Output
items: One small piece of useful documentation or automation
Feedback from an engineer or manager
A better understanding of infrastructure or security processes

mainFocus: Review progress, business value and whether the next development step should continue, change or pause.
projects: Progress review and next development plan
outcome: A simple evidence-based development plan that remains aligned with team priorities.

detailSections.title: Review Evidence
items: Completed learning or certification progress
Documentation produced
Automation prototypes or scripts reviewed
Exposure activities completed

detailSections.title: Next Decision
items: Continue with the current plan
Shift focus to a higher-value area
Identify a new supervised task or learning objective
